class.name: AITreeModel
class.brief_description: Loads and evaluates compact numeric gradient-boosted tree models.

method.name: clear
method.description: Unloads the model and clears [member last_error].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last load or prediction validation error, or an empty string after a successful operation.

method.name: get_num_classes
method.description: Returns the number of output classes, or [code]0[/code] when unloaded.

method.name: get_num_features
method.description: Returns the exact number of input features required by [method predict], or [code]0[/code] when unloaded.

method.name: get_num_trees
method.description: Returns the number of trees in the loaded ensemble, or [code]0[/code] when unloaded.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a structurally valid model is loaded.

method.name: load_from_buffer
method.description: Loads an XGB1 model from [param data]. The complete tree structure is validated before the model becomes available. On failure, the previous model is unloaded and [member last_error] describes the problem.

method.name: load_model
method.description: Loads an XGB1 model from [param path]. Both [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are supported. On failure, the previous model is unloaded and [member last_error] describes the problem.

method.name: predict
method.description: Evaluates the loaded ensemble. [param features] must contain exactly [member num_features] elements. Returns an empty array and sets [member last_error] if validation fails.

members.member: The last load or prediction validation error.
Whether a valid model is loaded.
The number of trees in the ensemble.
